power_leds.component.property.vf_red.sum: Typical forward voltage of the red die at 20 mA (datasheet). It rises slightly with current.
power_leds.component.property.rs_red.sum: Internal series resistance of the red die; sets how steeply the voltage rises with current.
power_leds.component.property.vbr_red.su: Reverse voltage at which the red die conducts backwards for a moment and is destroyed.
power_leds.component.property.wl_red.sum: Dominant wavelength of the red die.
power_leds.component.property.mcd_red.su: Typical luminous intensity of the red die at 20 mA. Output scales roughly with current.
power_leds.component.property.vf_green.s: Typical forward voltage of the green die at 20 mA (datasheet). It rises slightly with current.
power_leds.component.property.rs_green.s: Internal series resistance of the green die; sets how steeply the voltage rises with current.
Reverse voltage at which the green die conducts backwards for a moment and is destroyed.
power_leds.component.property.wl_green.s: Dominant wavelength of the green die.
Typical luminous intensity of the green die at 20 mA. Output scales roughly with current.
power_leds.component.property.vf_blue.su: Typical forward voltage of the blue die at 20 mA (datasheet). It rises slightly with current.
power_leds.component.property.rs_blue.su: Internal series resistance of the blue die; sets how steeply the voltage rises with current.
power_leds.component.property.vbr_blue.s: Reverse voltage at which the blue die conducts backwards for a moment and is destroyed.
power_leds.component.property.wl_blue.su: Dominant wavelength of the blue die.
power_leds.component.property.mcd_blue.s: Typical luminous intensity of the blue die at 20 mA. Output scales roughly with current.
power_leds.component.property.min_curren: Below this forward current the LED gives no visible light.
power_leds.component.property.reverse_ra: Rated maximum reverse voltage. LEDs block reverse current; exceeding the breakdown voltage destroys the die.
